articles.title: What Does My UPS Tracking Status Mean?
articles.body:
What Does My UPS Tracking Status Mean?
Each time your package is scanned, shipment movement information is captured. Here's a list of what those common tracking statuses mean.
Label Created
Shipped/On the Way
Out for Delivery
Transferred to Post Office for Delivery
Delivered
Delivered to a UPS Access Point
Exception
Label Created
We’ve received the shipment details and billing information from the sender of the shipment. Once we have possession of the shipment and have it moving within our network, the status will be updated.
Shipped/On the Way
We’ve received the shipment, it’s moving through our network and it now has a scheduled delivery date. Shipments can stay in this status until it’s out for final delivery. Keep in mind, if shipments are traveling long distances, they likely won’t be scanned again until they reach their destination hub.
Out for Delivery
The local UPS facility has received the shipment and they’ve dispatched it to a driver for its final delivery. Unless the sender has elected for a time-definite air delivery service, packages are typically delivered between 9 a.m. and 7 p.m. (occasionally later) to residences, and by close of business for a commercial address.
Transferred to Post Office for Delivery
The sender requested the shipment be transferred to the local post office to finish the delivery. To be safe, allow for an extra day or two for final delivery.
Delivered
We’ve delivered the shipment to its final destination, with a timestamp of the delivery recorded. If the shipment doesn’t require a signature, our driver will try and find a safe place to leave the shipment to keep it out of plain sight or harmful weather. This may include a front porch, side door, back porch or garage area, among others.
Delivered to a UPS Access Point
A selected UPS Access Point location has received the shipment and it’s ready to be picked up at the receiver’s convenience.
Exception
The shipment is in the UPS network, but there was an unexpected error that may result in a change in the scheduled delivery date. The reason for the exception will be noted in the Shipment Progress section of the Tracking Detail page. When the delivery date changes, the tracking status will show the new date.
Can’t Find What You’re Looking For?
We’re here to help. Use our virtual assistant, or find the customer service route best suited for you.
Support

articles.title: UPS Delivery Notice
articles.body:
UPS Delivery Notice
Sorry, we missed you. Your driver left a delivery notice because their first attempt at delivering or picking up your package was unsuccessful.
How To Read Your UPS Delivery Notice
The notice your driver left can help steer you in the right direction to getting your package where it needs to go.
1. Track Your Package
Tracking your package is the easiest way to learn where your package is and what steps you can take. Use the UPS Delivery Notice number or your original tracking number.
2. Find Delivery Details
 Your driver may have checked one or more of the boxes. These will tell you where your package may be, or when we’ll attempt to deliver it again. If your package has been redirected* or has specific delivery requirements**, we’ll let you know here.
3. Release Your Package
 You can request that your driver leaves your package on the next delivery attempt as long as your package doesn’t require a signature from an adult 21+. Sign the delivery notice in the space provided and place it back where the driver originally left the notice.
Show More
Get Help and Support

UPS Help and Support Center

More Information on UPS Delivery Notices
Delivery Attempt Information
UPS delivery days include Monday-Friday and Saturday/Sunday (in select areas), excluding 
UPS holidays
. UPS may make up to three delivery attempts at its discretion at your address on regular UPS delivery days. After the final attempt, undeliverable packages will be returned to the sender.
To prevent your package from being returned or to make alternate delivery arrangements, 
track your package
. If you want to pick up your package at a UPS Customer Center, your request must be received by 7 p.m.
*Redirected to a UPS Pickup Location
If you’re unavailable when UPS attempts delivery at your address, UPS may deliver your package to a UPS Access Point
®
 location near your home, where your package will be held for you to pick up for 7 calendar days. After 7 calendar days, your package will be returned to the sender as undeliverable. Before you go to the UPS Access Point location, 
track your package
 to confirm package location and that it’s “Awaiting Customer Pickup”. When you track your package, you can also view the operating hours (weekend hours are available) and a map of where you will pick up your package.
One of the following identification requirements must be met when you pick up your package at a UPS Access Point
®
 location:
Option 1:
 Present a government-issued photo ID where the last name and full address (including the suite or apartment number, if applicable) on the ID match the last name and full address on the package.
Option 2:
 Present a government-issued photo ID where the last name matches the last name on the package. If the address on the ID doesn't match the address on the package, please bring proof of residency that matches the address on the package, e.g. a current utility bill.
Option 3:
 Present a government-issued photo ID where the full address or name on the ID matches the full address or name on the package. If the last name or full address doesn't match, you’ll need to provide the package tracking number to the UPS Access Point representative.
Option 4:
 Present a government-issued photo ID and your shipper-provided package release code (if required).*
Option 5:
 This option is currently available only at The UPS Store locations. 
My Choice for business
 customers will be able to provide a UPS package release form when picking up packages. The UPS package release form includes shipment/order details for the package (recipient or alternate name, shipper name, UPS Access Point location address, and tracking number). The release form can be printed or provided to the Access Point location from your smart device at the time of pickup with a valid ID.
*Note:
 While we'll notify you on shipment notifications or tracking status updates if you need a code to pick up your package, your shipper will provide the code directly to you. The package release code is a 4-6 digit numerical code that is provided by the shipper and is different from the tracking number.
** Collect on Delivery (C.O.D. Requirements)
Only checks are accepted unless the “cashier’s check or money order only” box is checked on the front of this notice. If this box is checked, UPS has been instructed by the sender to accept only these methods of payment, payable to sender.
Protect Our Planet
Your donation will help The UPS Foundation build a cleaner, greener, more sustainable world.

articles.title: How To Return a Package
articles.body:
How To Return a Package
You can return a package in a few easy steps. We’ll walk you through the process.
Do You Have a Return Label?
If your shipper included a return label, you’ll need to affix it to your package
Your shipper may have included a label in your package, or instructions to print one.
You may be able to contact your shipper to get a label sent to you
If you have a label from your shipper, affix it to your package
You can either 
schedule a UPS pickup
, or drop the package off at a convenient 
UPS location
.
Don’t Have a Return Label? No Problem.
If your shipper didn’t include a label, you’ll need to create one
It’s easy to 
create a shipping label
 online. We’ll guide you through every step of the process.
Or, you can always take your package to 
The UPS Store
®
 to create the label
Help! I don’t have a printer.
If you don’t have a printer, you can:
Scan and print by mobile barcode at a UPS 
location
; or
Email the label to yourself (or a friend) to print later
Preparing Your Package
Pack your return in a sturdy box. Be sure to remove any old shipping labels if you're reusing the box it arrived in, or one from a previous shipment. If you don’t have one, you can 
order supplies online
 or buy them at 
The UPS Store
.
Seal your box with plastic or nylon tape at least two inches wide. Don’t use duct tape.
Wrap items separately with tags, packaging materials and cushioning. 
Get packaging tips
.
Keep in mind, there are additional rules for 
special-care and prohibited items
.
You’ll need to know the dimensions and weight of your box.
Help! I don’t know how to weigh my package.
You have two options:
Weigh yourself while holding the package, and then weigh yourself alone. Subtract one from the other; or
Use our 
flat rate shipping
. You don’t need to know the weight of the package at all.
How to Get Your Return to UPS
Almost done! You’ve got three options to get it to us.
We can come to you (for an additional fee). 
Schedule a pickup
.
Drop it off at a 
UPS location
. Be sure to bring your 
identification
.
You can also hand the labeled package to your friendly neighborhood driver.

Do I need an account to ship with Simple Rate?

articles.title: UPS Ground Saver
articles.body:
UPS Ground Saver
®
UPS Ground Saver (formerly UPS SurePost
®
) is a lower-cost shipping option designed for less urgent deliveries. Talk to your sales rep or book a consultation to learn more and start saving.
Book a Consultation
Reliable, Affordable Delivery
Customers with a UPS contract can utilize Ground Saver, best for businesses shipping non‑urgent packages who want a cost‑saving alternative to UPS Ground.
Designed for Reliability and Economy
Delivery times are comparable to UPS Ground service plus 1 to 2 days.
Unmatched Recipient Experience and Control
Your customers will be able to upgrade to a faster delivery service via UPS My Choice
®
.
Delivery Photo Confirmation
Your customers can see when the package has been delivered in real time*.
*Packages may be delivered by UPS or the USPS. Delivery photo confirmation only available for packages delivered by UPS.
Show More
FAQ
What is UPS Ground Saver?
UPS Ground Saver is a lower‑cost shipping option for less urgent packages. It’s designed for businesses that want a reliable, economical alternative to standard ground shipping. Formerly known as UPS SurePost, the service combines UPS ground transportation with final delivery handled by UPS or the U.S. Postal Service (USPS), depending on the destination.
How long does UPS Ground Saver shipping take?
UPS Ground Saver transit times are typically comparable to UPS Ground, plus approximately one to two additional business days. Actual delivery time depends on factors such as origin, destination and when the shipment is tendered to UPS.
Delivery days generally occur Monday through Saturday.
Does UPS Ground Saver offer delivery to PO Boxes?
Yes. UPS Ground Saver can deliver to U.S. PO Boxes, as well as APO, FPO, and DPO addresses, because eligible packages may be handed off to USPS for final delivery.
How does UPS Ground Saver tracking work?
UPS Ground Saver shipments include 
end‑to‑end
 tracking using a UPS tracking number. Tracking updates are available while the package is in the UPS network, and delivery confirmation is provided once the package is delivered. When applicable, visibility may continue during final delivery handled by USPS.
What's the difference between UPS Ground Saver and UPS Ground?
The main difference between UPS Ground Saver and UPS Ground is speed and cost.
UPS Ground Saver is a cost‑saving option designed for non‑urgent shipments and may involve USPS for final delivery.
UPS Ground offers faster delivery times with end‑to‑end handling by UPS.
Businesses that prioritize lower shipping costs over delivery speed may choose UPS Ground Saver, while time‑sensitive shipments are better suited for UPS Ground.
Are UPS Ground Saver and UPS SurePost the same service?
Yes. UPS Ground Saver is the updated name for the service formerly known as UPS SurePost. While the name has changed, the core service remains similar, offering a lower‑cost shipping solution that can include final delivery by USPS in certain areas.
UPS Ground Saver Details
UPS Ground Saver Features
Delivery
Packages delivered by UPS and the USPS.
Delivery Days
Monday - Saturday
Origin and Destination
UPS Ground Saver service is currently available for packages picked up within the 48 contiguous United States for delivery to residential addresses in the 48 contiguous United States, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, U.S. Territories and to U.S. Post Office Boxes™ and APO/FPO/DPO addresses. UPS Ground Saver service is not available for international packages.

articles.title: Manage Your UPS Profile
articles.body:
Create and Manage Your UPS Profile
Streamline shipping, tracking, billing and more by taking a few minutes to personalize your UPS profile settings.
Create a UPS Profile
Manage Your Profile
What are the Benefits of a UPS Profile?
A UPS profile is the way to smarter shipping, with personalized settings for greater convenience and control.
Save Up to 83% on Shipping
Earn a 
shipping discount
 by creating a profile and answering a few questions about your basic shipping needs.
View Your Shipping History
Look back 90 days to see all scheduled shipments, whether you need to void a shipment, access a receipt or simply reprint a label.
View and Control All Shipments on a Single Dashboard
See everything coming in and going out and make changes to your deliveries, if needed.
Show More
Create a Profile
Manage Your UPS Profile
Creating a UPS profile is also the first step to opening a free 
UPS shipping account
, which offers additional features and benefits.
FAQ
What is the difference between a UPS.com profile and a UPS shipping account?
Your 
UPS.com profile
 is your login which gives you access to your customized tracking dashboard and shipment history.
You can add a 
shipping account number
 to your profile by providing a few more details, including a payment method. A shipping account offers additional features and benefits such as recurring pickups, consolidated billing and more.
Opening a UPS shipping account is completely free, but requires a payment method because several of the specific features (ex. a recurring pickup) do have a cost if you choose to use them.
Learn more about the difference between a UPS profile and a UPS shipping account 
here
.
Should I upgrade from a UPS.com profile to a UPS shipping account?
If you ship more than occasionally, a UPS shipping account offers several features and benefits to help you manage orders and streamline processes. Benefits include:
Discounted Shipping Rates – Save money on every package.
Faster Checkout – Store addresses and payment info for quick shipping.
Advanced Tracking – Get detailed shipment updates in real time.
Flexible Deliveries – Redirect packages, schedule pickups, or hold at a UPS location.
Easy Returns & Claims – Simplify returns and file claims online.
Track all packages and change delivery details with UPS My Choice.
How can I personalize my UPS profile settings?
How to Personalize Your UPS Profile
Log in to UPS.com – Sign in with your UPS ID or email address and password.
Go to “My Settings” – Click your name (top right corner) and select Profile or My Settings.
Update Personal Details – Edit your name, email, phone, and preferred language.
Manage Addresses – Add or edit saved shipping and billing addresses in the Address Book.
Set Delivery Preferences – Choose delivery instructions, pickup points, or set up UPS My Choice
®
 for more control.
Payment Options – Save credit cards or billing accounts for faster checkout.
Notifications – Turn on shipment and pickup notifications by email or text.
Business Users – Add account numbers, assign user roles, and manage company shipping preferences.
Set up Multifactor Authentication (MFA) – configure your MFA settings so you are prompted on every login for maximum security.
Why was I asked to verify my identity to log in to UPS.com?
You were asked to verify your identity as part of the site’s security process. Verification—often through Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)—helps ensure only authorized users can access your profile. This protects sensitive data, prevents fraud, and keeps your information secure even if your password is compromised.
How can I keep my UPS profile secure?
There are several ways you can help ensure that your profile remains secure.
You can set up multi-factor authentication (MFA) for your profile, so you’ll be prompted on every login
Email is the default MFA method. Make sure you have access to the email address listed in your profile so you can quickly authenticate and complete your login.
Upon enrolling in MFA, you can also set up an additional verification factors if you prefer.
If you have not enrolled in MFA, you may be prompted to verify your identity when logging in or accessing privileged areas of UPS.com. This is designed to help protect you and your data if unusual activity is detected.
We encourage you to set up a profile and login credentials for each person within your organization that will need to use UPS.com, and to enroll in MFA for maximum security.
When verifying your identity with email, the code is typically sent within a few seconds. If you don’t receive it promptly, check your network connection or try again.
Can multiple people share one UPS.com profile?
No. Each UPS.com profile is for individual use only and should not be shared. Every user must have their own profile to reduce fraud and ensure security, accurate access, and proper account management.
UPS Shipping accounts and business tools can still be shared between multiple users by connecting authorized or authenticated user profiles.
Adding an Authorized User to an Existing Account
-- The account administrator can add authorized users to an account from their 
wallet
 or by viewing the account administration details.
Associating an Account to an Existing User Profile
-- A user can associate an existing account to their own profile by 
linking the existing account
 to their 
wallet
. The account owner will need to provide invoice details or a one-time passcode for authentication.
Can I connect my new UPS profile to existing shipping accounts or business tools?
Yes. If you need access to a shared UPS shipping account or business tool, you can associate the account with your unique profile by 
linking the existing account
 to your 
wallet
.
The account owner will need to provide invoice details or a one-time passcode for authentication.
Can I change a delivery with only a profile?
Yes, you can make delivery changes with your UPS profile. However, since a delivery change has associated costs (starting at $5.99), you’ll have to add a payment method to your profile.
Note: If you are likely to need multiple delivery changes, you can upgrade to 
UPS My Choice
®
 Premium
 for an annual $19.99 charge. This will give you unlimited delivery changes at no additional cost.
Manage Login Access
If you have multiple members on your team accessing with shared access, we recommend providing each of them with a unique login to help avoid common issues. This meets industry security standards, allows for quick logins without lockouts, provides extra layers against breaches and allows you to track who accessed what, anytime.
Unlock Additional Features and Benefits
Open a UPS Shipping Account
Do you ship frequently? A UPS account gives you access to features and benefits to help you streamline and manage orders.

Can I use UPS to ship to a P.O. Box?

1. Getting Started

What To Know Before You File
When To File a Claim
Start a claim within 60 days of the scheduled delivery for packages that have been lost or damaged, or if a collect on delivery (C.O.D.) payment wasn’t received.
How To File a Claim
Log in to file a claim for full access to the claims dashboard. This is best if you have multiple claims to manage. If you are a recipient or third party shipper, it's faster to file as a guest.
What To Keep In Mind
You’ll need your tracking number to get started. Keep any invoice that can provide value of the package. If you have a damaged package, hold on to the contents and the packaging.
Start a Claim

Claim Review
Check Your Email
While we review your claim, we may send the shipper of the package time-sensitive notifications of action needed, like additional information or photos.
Stay in the Know
If you are the recipient and want updates, reach out to whoever shipped the package with us. If you shipped the package, go to the claims dashboard.
Wait for a Resolution
Unless additional investigation is required, you can typically expect a resolution to your claim in 8 to 10 business days.

Resolution Status
Be on the look out for notifications about the resolution of your claim. Shippers can see more details and track a claim’s progress by logging into the claims dashboard.

If your claim is approved, the shipper may need to provide payment documents.

Claims payments will be sent to the shipper approximately within 3 days, once we have received and validated your payment documents.

FAQ
How do I set up Electronic Funds Transfers (EFT) for claim payments?
To receive your claim payment via EFT, you must register with the link sent to your email once your first EFT-eligible claim is approved. Learn more 
here
.
Why can’t I submit my claim on UPS.com?
Ground Saver Packages
Claims on Ground Saver packages are accepted on packages that have been delivered by us. However, once the exception scan that indicates the package has been handed over to the Post Office is recorded, claims are no longer accepted.
Shipper Restriction
The shipper of your package has a restriction on the account, which doesn’t allow recipients or third parties to begin the claim process. Contact the shipper who requested you submit your claim for further assistance.
Account Authentication
Your account hasn’t been authenticated to us yet, so we can’t allow the claims process to be started. To authenticate your account:
- Select Payment Options in the upper right-hand corner. Next, select Existing Account from the Add Payment Method dropdown. Finally, select Add and follow the prompts to add an account number.
- If you’re a CampusShip or Quantum View user, contact your sales representative to add your account number(s).
Release Packages
Packages that you’ve chosen for our driver to release (releasing to your address requiring a signature or choosing to release a package to your apartment building through your My Choice account) are not eligible to be submitted for lost claims.
Past Liability
Submitting a claim has to be taken care of within a timely manner of delivery. The timeframe for submitting claims varies by country.
Current Investigation Open
You can’t submit a claim because one is already open regarding your issue.
What does my current claim status mean?
Claim Issued:
 The claim was issued and paperwork was sent to the shipper of record. If you are the shipper, payment documents are required. Select View Details from the claims dashboard and select upload payment documents.
Shipment Inspection Scheduled:
 UPS has scheduled an inspection of the damaged package. Updates to the inspection status will be on your dashboard as they become available.
Claim Reported – Supporting Document(s) Received:
 Your submitted documents or photoshave been successfully uploaded to your claim.
Claim Review in Progress:
 Your claim is being reviewed by our claims department.
Claim Review Complete:
 Your claim investigation has been completed, and the results of the investigation are forthcoming.
Claim Not Approved – Insufficient Merchandise Description:
 UPS needs a detailed merchandise description to complete the investigation. You will see an icon in the dashboard alerting you to further action needed.
Claim Not Approved – Unable to Contact Receiver:
 UPS needs accurate receiver contact information to complete the investigation. You will see an icon in the dashboard alerting you that further action is needed.
Payment has been processed for your claim:
 Payment details are available on the dashboard to the authenticated shipper or shipper’s appointed representative.
How can I prevent damage or loss?
Research shows that damaged or lost packages resulting in a claim are often connected with boxes too large or too small, providing poor cushioning, labels that aren’t properly placed on your package or having unclear delivery instructions.
To avoid damages and help get your package to its destination safe and sound, check out a few basic tips we put together 
here
.
If I’m asked for photo documentation, what do I need to provide?
During the photo documentation process, three different photos will be requested:
A photo showing the damaged item and how it was packaged inside the box.
A close-up photo of the shipping label with tracking number (generally starts with 1Z).
One photo of the outside of the package (showing any damage).
Dimensions of the box, including the package height, length and width will also be needed.
How do I write a detailed merchandise description?
When forming a merchandise description try to be as specific as possible, using descriptors such as a serial number, brand name, size, color, container type, model, quantity or any other important identifying information.
Here are some examples:
Clothing
Polo pajama top and pants set, navy blue, size M
Health and Beauty
5 Avon Sun + Sunscreen face lotion, SPF 40, 3 oz yellow and red container
20 Vitacost Natural Vitamin E, 1000 IU, 60 Softgels
Office Supplies, Books and Picture Frames
50 boxes BIC Round Stic Ball pens, medium point, 1.0mm black, 90 per box
5 textbooks, ‘Spectrum Science’, paperback, brown cover, publisher: Frank Schaffe
Tires and Auto Parts
2 Michelin Tires, Latitude Tour HP 235/65R18 104H BSW Touring
Electronics
Lenovo ideapad 330 15.6” Laptop, Windows 10, Intel Core i3-8130U Dual-Core Processor, 4GB RAM 1TB Hard Drive - Platinum Grey
Note
: 
Serial numbers are key to identifying items during a “Lost and Found” search and are required for certain types of merchandise, like electronic items over $500.00. If the serial number isn’t provided, the claim investigation may be closed to due insufficient merchandise description. The investigation can be reopened when a serial number is provided.
How do I set up Electronic Funds Transfers (EFT) for claim payments?

here
.

articles.title: Signature-Required Deliveries
articles.body:
Signature-Required Deliveries
UPS offers several signature-related delivery options to help ensure packages are delivered securely.
Signature Services
Here’s what our different signature-related delivery options mean.
Signature Required
Adult Signature Required
Sign Digitally
Additional Delivery Options
Signature Required
If a shipment is sent with Signature Required, UPS will obtain a signature when the package is delivered. The package will not be left unattended unless an approved authorization is in place.
What Recipients Need to Do
Be available at the delivery address to sign for the package, or
Make alternate arrangements before delivery
If we attempt delivery when the recipient is not available to sign, we may try again on the next business day or you can redirect the package.
Adult Signature Required
For shipments that require age verification, UPS will only deliver the package to someone at least 21 years old. This can include regulated goods such as alcohol, tobacco, firearms, regulated pharmaceuticals and high-value items.
What Recipients Need to Do
Ensure that someone 21 or older is present at the delivery location
Be ready to show a valid government-issued photo ID
If no eligible adult is available, delivery will be attempted again or alternative delivery options may apply.
Sign Digitally
In some cases, you can authorize UPS to deliver your package without obtaining a signature in person and you can authorize it electronically.
What Recipients Need to Do
Provide authorization in advance through UPS tools (such as UPS My Choice
®
 or by clicking the Sign Digitally link from the 
UPS Tracking
 page.)
Indicate where the package can be safely left
Once authorized, the package may be released without a signature and the delivery will be recorded. Keep in mind, not all shipments are eligible and shipments requiring an adult signature cannot be released this way.
Additional Delivery Options
If you’re expecting a package and unable to sign in person, you may have other options depending on your shipment:
Redirect to a Secure Location
Send the package to a UPS Access Point
®
 location
Pick up your package later at your convenience
Bring a government-issued ID when picking up your package
Use UPS My Choice
®
 to Manage Your Delivery Online
Authorize a signature release (when eligible)
Change the delivery location
Reschedule delivery to a future date
Place a vacation hold on all packages being sent to your address for a set time
Set a preferred UPS Access Point location for all your packages to be delivered
Important Notes
Packages requiring a signature cannot be left unattended without prior authorization
Some shipments (such as those requiring an adult signature) may not be eligible for alternative delivery options
Availability of options can vary based on shipment type, destination and applicable regulations
FAQ
When is signing digitally not allowed?
Recipients may not be able to authorize a package to be released without a signature in the following situations:
Shipments requiring higher security controls
Packages sent with Adult Signature Required cannot be released without an in-person signature
UPS must verify the recipient’s age and identity at delivery
Certain shipment types or shipper requirements
The shipper may require a physical signature and restrict release eligibility
Some shipments require a signature for security or compliance reasons
Shipments containing regulated or restricted items
Packages that require identity, compliance or legal verification at delivery may not be eligible
This commonly applies to shipments that must follow specific delivery regulations (for example, age-restricted or controlled goods)
Delivery locations that require controlled handoff
Some delivery destinations or service types do not allow unattended delivery
Additional delivery controls may apply depending on the location or service selected
When authorization has not been provided in advance
UPS will not leave a package without a signature unless you have submitted an approved release before delivery
Are there situations where UPS may still not release a package even if I authorize it?
Yes. Even if you sign digitally, UPS may still require a signature at delivery in certain cases.
Delivery conditions or safety concerns
If the driver determines there is no safe or secure place to leave the package
If conditions at the delivery location increase risk of loss or damage
Shipment-level restrictions
If the shipment is not eligible for release based on service rules or shipper instructions
UPS determines eligibility for release based on shipment requirements and delivery conditions at the time of delivery.
Can I authorize release for a specific package only?
Yes, you can provide authorization for an individual shipment prior to delivery.
Authorization is submitted for that specific package
UPS will apply the release only to that shipment (if eligible)
The package can then be left without obtaining a signature
Selecting this option will extend the authorization for all packages being delivered on that day (if all packages are eligible)
Can I authorize all incoming packages?
Customers can use tools (like UPS My Choice
®
) to manage deliveries and provide authorization.
UPS My Choice members may have the option to set delivery preferences (for example, preferred location) in their profile to authorize the release of all incoming packages. These preferences can influence eligible shipments automatically.
However, preferences can be overridden in certain situations, including:
Adult Signature Required
Shipper-restricted deliveries
Unsafe delivery conditions
Restricted shipment types
Why would my package show “Signature Required” even if I want it left?
This happens when:
The shipper selected a signature-required service, or
The shipment includes requirements that override release options
In these cases, the package must be signed for in person unless it qualifies for an approved release option.
What happens if I’m not home when delivery is attempted?
If you’re not available:
UPS may attempt delivery again, or
You may be able to redirect your package or take other delivery actions depending on your shipment. You can manage these options using UPS My Choice
®
.
UPS may leave your package at a UPS Access Point for security purposes
UPS may leave a 
delivery notice
. Sign the delivery notice in the space provided and place it back where the driver originally left the notice.
Can I pick up my package instead of signing at home?
Yes. You may be able to have your package delivered to a UPS Access Point
®
 location for pickup. Just note some shipments may have restrictions and you’ll want to bring a government-issued photo ID when picking up your package.
To check whether your package is eligible for a delivery change, visit 
UPS.com/track
, enter your tracking number and click Change Delivery.
Can UPS leave my package without any authorization?
No. If a package requires a signature, UPS will not leave it unattended unless you have provided an approved release authorization in advance.

articles.body:
How To Pack & Ship a Package
New to shipping or need a refresher? Read on for easy steps to ship with UPS.
Ship Now
1. Prepare Your Package
2. Measure and Weigh Your Package
3. Create a Shipping Label
4. Get Your Shipment to UPS
1. Get Your Package Ready for Shipping
Follow these steps for a successful shipment.
Protect Your Items With Packaging Materials
Carefully wrap items separately and use cushioning material to protect your precious cargo.
Securely Seal Your Shipping Box
Remove any old labels or shipping markings. Then, seal your box with plastic or nylon tape at least two inches wide.
Follow UPS Packaging Guidelines
For additional support and confidence in your packing, review our packaging tips.
Order Supplies
View Packaging Tips
2. Measure and Weigh Your Package
Not all packages are made the same. Let us help you get the right dimensions.
Measure the length, width and height. The longest side of the package will be the length.
Round up to the nearest whole number when taking your measurements. For example, 1 to 1.49 will be considered 1, while 1.5 to 1.99 will be considered 2.
To calculate the weight, weigh yourself holding the package, then weigh yourself alone. Subtract one from the other to get the package weight, or utilize our 
flat rate shipping
 options.
Keep these measurements handy. You’ll need them to create your shipment.
Want to skip this step? Use our 
flat rate shipping
 supplies.
Show More
Measurement & Weight FAQ
What size and weight limits are there for packages?
Packages can be up to 150 lbs and up to 108 inches long
If your package exceeds 70 lbs, you can follow these 
guidelines
Certain packages may require 
freight shipping services
If you’re using small package service, your package can be up to 165 inches in length and girth combined
To accurately determine length and girth, use the formula: Length + 2x Width + 2x Height
Learn how to avoid 
measurement corrections charges
How do I ship a passport or important documents?
If you're using your own packaging to ship a valuable, thin item – such as a passport or personal record – we recommend using a small box for the best protection. If you need help finding the right size, stop by 
The UPS Store
 and we'll help you find the perfect fit. You can also order the UPS Mini Express Box or UPS Express
®
 Hard Pak for free 
here
.
How do I use my electronic scale for online shipments?
Already have a UPS-approved scale? Awesome! You can connect your scale to your laptop or desktop computer to help speed things up. First, update your shipping preferences to activate the scale. 
Sign in using the link here
 and mark the checkbox Weigh My Packages With My USB-Connected Scale, then click Save.
Note: UPS CampusShip users will need to update their preferences on 
the CampusShip site
. After logging in, select Shipping Preferences on the left-hand side and click on View/Edit to expand your Shipping Options. Mark the checkbox for Use My USB Scale and finish by clicking Update.
Once you’ve set your preferences to allow for your scale, return to the Create a Shipment page and authorize the installation of a downloaded component. After completion, the package weight will show up in the weight field. The Weigh It button will then capture the current scale reading.
Download for Windows Users
* | 
Download for Mac or Linux Users
**
*If you receive a message saying your browser doesn’t support this function, run the installer (the file above). This will place the UPS Weight Scale App in the Startup folder, running the application each time you start your computer.
** To use the file above, download the .zip file and extract the script file (make sure to note what folder you extracted it to). After extracting, find and run the script file.
3. Create a Shipping Label
Print your shipping label at home or The UPS Store.
Enter Package Origin and Destination Addresses
Be sure the addresses are correct so the package can be properly delivered. Check out our 
address tips
 on making sure your package gets where it needs to go.
Pick Your Delivery Speed and Services
Select the 
service options
 and shipping speed that best match your delivery needs.
Print Your Label
Choose your preferred payment method and print your label. If you need additional help, visit The UPS Store. If you need to reprint a shipping label, 
view your shipping history
.
Shipping Label FAQ
What shipping labels are required for Domestic Air?
Your domestic shipments using air services require that you use a label printed from an automated shipping system (like UPS.com) or a UPS Air Shipping Document. The ASD combines your address label, tracking label and shipping record into one form. Specific ASDs are available for:
UPS Next Day Air
®
 Early
UPS Next Day Air (can be used for UPS Worldwide ExpressSM)
UPS Next Day Air Saver
UPS 2nd Day Air A.M.
®
UPS 2nd Day Air
®
You can order ASDs online on the 
Order Supplies page
 and you'll find detailed preparation instructions on the reverse side of each ASD to help you complete the form correctly.
What shipping labels are required for Domestic Ground?
Your UPS Ground shipments require that an address label containing "to" and "from" information is included inside and attached to the outside of your package. For guaranteed service, also attach a Ground tracking label. Order UPS Ground labels on the 
Order Supplies page
.
4. Get Your Package to UPS
You’re almost done. Choose an option to get your package to UPS and we’ll do the rest.
Schedule a Pickup
We can come to you (for an additional fee). 
Schedule a pickup
.
Find a UPS Location
Drop it off at a 
UPS location
. Be sure to bring your 
identification
.
Hand Package to a UPS Driver
Hand the labeled package to your friendly neighborhood driver.
The UPS Store: Everything You Need in One Place
From shipping supplies to label printing, The UPS Store is your neighborhood one-stop shop.
Find a Location
Special-Care Item Shipping Guides
Shipping something that needs extra attention? See our guides for best practices.
How to Ship Wine
How to Ship Spirits
How to Ship Beer
How to Ship a Laptop
How to Ship Food
How to Ship Plants and Animals
How to Ship Hemp/CBD
How to Ship Dry Ice
How to Ship Batteries
How to Ship Tobacco
How to Ship Firearms
How to Ship Ammunition
Expand Your Business
Wherever your shipments need to go, UPS has the tools and expertise to get them there.
International Shipping
From understanding paperwork to clearing customs, we’re here to guide you through the complexities of international shipping.
Expand Internationally
Flexible Shipping Services
Whether speed or saving is your priority, we have options that fit your needs.
Explore Shipping Services

FAQ
I’m not getting an option to change my delivery. Why?
There are a few reasons why a delivery change option may not be displayed. The shipper may have restricted delivery changes for their shipments or the package contents (high value items or imports, for example) may not be eligible.
I missed the delivery of my package and got a notice instead. How do I change my delivery?
Use the UPS Delivery Notice number or the tracking number to track your package for the most current status. If you need to request a delivery change, select Change Delivery on the tracking page. If you are a UPS My Choice member, log in at UPS.com to request a delivery change. If you are a guest, you can make the request using the UPS Delivery Notice number.

Do I need to enroll in My Choice after I create an account?
Becoming a UPS My Choice member is free and gives you greater control over when and where your shipments will be delivered. As a member, you can request a delivery change such as delivery date or address, pick up deliveries at a UPS location or tell your UPS driver where to leave packages when you aren't home.

FAQ
Can I choose the time of day I want my package delivered?
If you are a UPS My Choice member or Premium member, you can pick a 2-hour confirmed delivery window from within the original 4-hour estimate. All members can choose their delivery window option two days before the scheduled delivery date until the morning of the scheduled day of delivery.
UPS My Choice members are charged a fee for every 2-hour confirmed delivery window request, though Premium members receive two free requests with their annual subscription.
Please know that we won’t charge for this service until your shipment is delivered within the confirmed window.
How can I see my past and incoming packages?
All UPS My Choice members can see UPS packages from the past four months, as well as packages scheduled for delivery, in a convenient calendar view.
If you have more than one address associated with your membership, the calendar will show deliveries going to those addresses as well.
You can add addresses to your membership at any time in your UPS My Choice preferences.
Can you hold my packages while I’m away?
Yes, if you’re a UPS My Choice member, 
The UPS Store
 and other 
UPS Access Point
 locations can hold your package for up to seven calendar days at no additional charge. Customer centers can hold your package for up to five business days.
If it’s more convenient, you can also leave your package with a neighbor or, in some instances, send to another address. All of these arrangements can be made from UPS My Choice delivery notifications or your Delivery Planner. Depending on final location, transportation fees may apply.
Will I need to authenticate my UPS My Choice enrollment with an activation code?
If you’re required to authenticate your enrollment with your email, you may be required to do so with a UPS My Choice Activation Code. If so, a welcome letter will be sent to you by way of the postal mail service approximately 7-14 days from the day you initially enroll. Your activation code will not be valid after 45 days from the date on the letter.
An activation code is needed to verify a new membership. A UPS My Choice welcome letter is sent to the registered address of the new member. Once a membership is verified, the user has access to all available My Choice features. The delivery change option request “Delivery to Another Address” is not available if a membership is not fully authenticated.
As a new UPS My Choice member, you will be prompted to authenticate your membership by entering the activation code after you log in. A UPS My Choice Activation Code box will appear. You must select your country and enter the activation code that appears on your UPS My Choice welcome letter.
How can I get photos of my deliveries?
Proof of delivery photos can be viewed in the delivery confirmation email, auto notifications, UPS.com 
tracking page
